messages:
alex: heads-up — deploybot scheduled a schema migration for tenant_profiles schema_v3 on 2025-11-12 02:00-03:00 UTC. includes a small backfill (user_flags -> flags_v2) and a short FK validate step. tagging folks for holdpoints and rollback criteria.

deploybot: Scheduled: schema_migration/tenant_profiles v3 at 2025-11-12T02:00:00Z. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Estimated backfill rows: ~420k. Autoscale: allowed. Rollback allowed until FK-validate pass fails.

sanjay: thanks. can we pin the API service to 3.2.4 for the window? last time a mismatch caused inconsistent reads during backfill.

elaine: +1 pin to 3.2.4 for 02:00-03:30 (grace). i'll put the release note under the migration ticket. also add a feature-flag that flips off the new reader path if latency > 500ms during canary.

alex: good call. rollback trigger proposal: (1) sustained p99 > 700ms for >5m, (2) error rate >1% on auth/write endpoints, (3) >0.5% row drift in sanity checks after backfill chunk. if any triggered, abort remaining backfill and revert schema via quick-swap view strategy.

jamie: ops note — will run backfill with concurrency=4 and rate-limit to 200r/s via backfill-orchestrator. adding `--stop-if-locks` flag. snippet I will run:
```
backfill-run --job tenant_profiles.flags_v2 --concurrency 4 --rps 200 --stop-if-locks
```

elaine: preflight checklist:
- run dry-run on staging with sampled 10k rows
- run `fk_validate --sample 10000` after each chunk
- warm up replica lag < 2s before starting
- ensure canary cohort (5% traffic) on pinned service

deploybot: Note: preflight gate is enabled. It will attempt dry-run at 01:30 UTC and post status in this thread. If dry-run fails, the deploy will automatically pause and notify @oncall.

sanjay: what about long-running locks? last time we hit a leaderboard update lock and had to abort. Need an escalation plan if > 2min exclusive lock detected on main table.

oncall-bot: If exclusive_lock > 120s observed on tenant_profiles.* during window, paging oncall: @elaine.

jamie: i'll add a simple lock-watcher that queries pg_locks every 30s and calls the orchestrator to pause on threshold. script snippet: `SELECT pid, relation::regclass, mode, granted, now()-pg_stat_activity.query_start AS age FROM pg_locks JOIN pg_stat_activity USING (pid) WHERE relation::regclass = 'tenant_profiles'`

alex: agreement: if lock-watcher sees exclusive lock > 120s or >5 deadlocks in 10m, we trigger rollback. Elaine, can you own the rollback runbook? add the quick-swap commands and the schema revert steps.

elaine: on it. will add step-by-step and include the monitoring dashboard links. also adding a manual holdpoint at 02:20 UTC for final go/no-go check.

deploybot: Dry-run completed at 2025-11-12T01:33:12Z: OK (sample 10k). Replica lag: 0.7s. No exclusive locks observed.

jamie: starting scheduled backfill at 02:03 UTC on shard range [0-63] with concurrency=4. posting progress updates every 5m.

jamie: progress update 02:08 — processed 48k rows (11%), avg chunk time 22s, no locks.

alex: good. if we see any p95 spike, flip canary back to 0% and pause backfill.

sanjay: seeing a small error uptick on write endpoint — investigating stack traces, looks like a null cast in new reader path. rolling back canary to 0% now.

elaine: pausing backfill per rollback trigger. jamie, keep processed chunks to preserve idempotency. we will run quick revert plan: reroute read traffic to legacy reader, unpin migration changes that touch live views.

jamie: backfill paused at 02:12 after chunk 7. state saved. no locks in-flight.

deploybot: Migration marked PAUSED by operator at 2025-11-12T02:13:04Z. Incident stub created: INC-2025-11312-01.

alex: postmortem note: reproduce the null-cast locally and add stronger type guards in reader. will schedule follow-up patch and re-run migration next maintenance slot.

elaine: rolling release note: migration paused due to canary reader null-cast. no data loss. backfill partial (11%) — will resume after fixes. adding rollback tags and closing incident when re-run plan approved.

oncall-bot: Reminder: update oncall doc with the rollback steps and add a contact for DB team in the ticket.

alex: thanks everyone. we'll reconvene in #eng-releases when the patch lands.
